# Knowledge-Core-Web: Constraints

- Web does not own backend data access and must not bypass Gateway.
- Production images use immutable Harbor digests.
- Do not commit plaintext secrets or force-push shared history.
- Gateway routes and network policies are owned by k3s configuration, not this repository.
- `/api/health` checks the web process only; Gateway dependence is verified by smoke.
